quest.title: Animal Research: Frostfin Whales
quest.description: It is said that a pink Frostfin Whale has been spotted in the waters northwest of Lempo Isle...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Looks like today's not our lucky day... We've been waiting so long and haven't even spotted a single ordinary Frostfin Whale...

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Hmm... Maybe we should call it a day and head back. There'll be other chances.

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: But... you're only back for a short while before you leave for other places again, right?

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Let's wait a bit longer, then.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Wait... Helka, is that you?

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Linnea! Yes, I'm back. But my archive isn't quite complete yet, so our showdown will have to wait.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Oh? So the trip was fruitful, then. I haven't been idle either, and I added quite a bit to my own records.

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Did you come to see the Frostfin Whale too?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Yes. I heard it was only discovered recently. Considering its size, I suspect environmental changes caused the shift in its skin color.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Like the concentration of kuuvahki in the area, for example...

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: It's a shame, but we probably won't see it today. We've waited so long, and we've got nothing to show for it.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Linnea... back me up here! Let's just call it a day and head back, Maisie...

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: I'm fine. I feel better than usual since I woke up this morning. Let's wait a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: I heard that anyone who sees the Frostfin Whale can have their wish come true. So... it's supposed to bring good luck, right?

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: I hope you can take the luck it brings with you on your next journey, Helka.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: But...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Let's wait together, then.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: ...Linnea!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I have a feeling we're going to see that Frostfin Whale today.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: You know how it is, Helka. My instincts are always right.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Alright... then we'll wait a little longer. But just a little, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A while later...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Look, look! Wow, it jumped so high!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I wish I could swim that fast too... Swimming with them must be so much fun!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Let's just jump in now—

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Hey! That's too dangerous! Geez, nothing's changed while I was away. You're still as reckless as ever...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: W—What? Don't you want to play with them too? They're having so much fun!

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: But if your clothes get wet, you might catch a cold. Why not stay on shore and use the Kamera to capture them having fun?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Hmm... makes sense. Then I'll borrow Helka's Kamera for a bit.

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Linnea quickly makes the necessary preparations for the investigation...

talks.objective: Take a photo of the Frostfin Whale

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There seems to be something nearby worth examining. <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color>, with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: That was a great shot!

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Feeling satisfied now?

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Mhm! Whether the legend's true or not, I hope that, wherever you go, Helka, luck will see you through any danger and bring you back to Speranza, safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: ...Thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: Hehe, shall we head back then? Thanks so much, Linnea! See you at Speranza!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm! See you there!

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: There's nothing there...

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Seems like today is not our lucky day.
